command: claude --permission-mode auto (interactive TUI, driven under a pty), prompted to dispatch a Task subagent
note: The first REAL SubagentStart/SubagentStop bytes for CC — tests/sources/claude/fixtures/lifecycle-recorded predates the shim stamps. Ships the PARENT transcript, because that is where the dispatch lives AND what the hooks key on; the child's own transcript (where `attributionAgent` lives) is a separate scenario for the same reason. The tool is named `Agent`, not `Task` — CC renamed it undocumented in v2.1.63 — which is why detection is semantic on `subagent_type`. The recorder's own roster and instruction attachments rode fields no decoder reads and are stripped (see `deidentified`).
